name: @hasna/contacts
description: Contact management for AI coding agents — CLI + MCP + Web

scripts.build: bun run clean && cd dashboard && bun run build && cd .. && bun run build:bundles && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.build:core: bun run clean:core && bun run build:bundles && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.build:bundles: bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external pg --external @hasna/contracts --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external pg --external @hasna/contracts --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external pg --external @hasna/contracts && bun build src/sdk/index.ts --outdir dist/sdk --target bun && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external pg --external @hasna/contracts
scripts.build:server: rm -rf dist/server dist/sdk && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external pg --external @hasna/contracts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build

author: Andrei Hasna <andrei@hasna.com>
